target_customer: Engineering teams that ship code with AI assistance and want PRs verified at runtime
problem: Code review and unit tests miss bugs that only show up at runtime, such as service failures, concurrent requests and restarts mid job.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription, listed Pro plan at 150 dollars per month and custom enterprise
product_category: AI code review and runtime verification (originally open source on-call alert triage)

founders.name: Abhishek Ray
founders.background_notes: YC page says early engineer at Robinhood for about 5 years and at Quora.

founders.name: Amaresh
founders.background_notes: YC page gives only a first name and says he and Abhishek have on-call experience at companies including Robinhood and Atlassian. Which employer is his is not stated.

technical_complexity.rationale: Alert classification was modest. The current product needs realistic service simulation and failure injection per PR, which is harder.

defensibility.rationale: Open source origin and a crowded AI code review and AI SRE space make copying easy.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Not established from sources. Observability vendors later shipped AI SRE agents per 2026 comparison pages.

market_need_then: On-call alert fatigue was the pain stated in the July 2024 YC launch post. Independent dated spend evidence was not collected.

identity.visual_style: Terminal style code prompts and before and after panels
identity.voice_and_tone: Direct and confident, tagline The reliability company

branding.community_and_virality: Open source GitHub repo and a Show HN post by the founder.

brand_strength.rationale: Developer oriented voice but little coverage of the brand itself.

pivots.from: Open source Slack bot that classifies Datadog alerts as actionable or noisy (launch July 2024)
pivots.to: AI code review that runs the app on each PR
pivots.why: Not stated. Date not found; the Show HN post also describes a session watching bug fixer, so the product shifted more than once.

outcome_analysis: Opslane is active with a one person team listed. It launched as an open source on-call tool in July 2024 and later shifted toward verifying AI generated code. No named paying customers or rounds beyond the standard YC deal were found, so traction is unknown.
notes: A 500K YC investment dated 2024-09-25 appears only in aggregators and is the standard YC deal, not recorded as a round. Competitor searches returned only 2026 AI SRE comparison pages, so the dated list is empty. Founder education not found.
